## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is an exceptionally capable, farseeing, and practical woman who prides herself on being an honest judge of human nature and speaking her mind without fear or favor. Highly observant and naturally curious, she is known as an outspoken gossip who can be critical and bossy, often attempting to manage and properly bring up those around her regardless of their age. Despite her strict and matter-of-fact demeanor, she possesses a kind, generous heart, never shirking her share of work, helping the poor, and keeping a box of cookies for others. She is a pious church member deeply devoted to church affairs who believes that everything is foreordained, though she remains opposed to the higher education of women and holds dubious views regarding the propriety of fiction writing. Additionally, she loves to be asked for advice, can admit to her own mistakes, and holds a first-prize skill in making homemade butter and cheese.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde, a notable resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who brought up ten children and buried two, initially expressed strong disapproval when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) decided to adopt an orphan girl named [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Upon meeting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Mrs. Rachel offended the girl with blunt remarks about her red hair, provoking a fiery rage from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that resulted in a dramatic apology before Mrs. Rachel completely forgave her. Over the years, she frequently shared news and advice with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), advising her on Anne's upbringing and school affairs, as well as assisting [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) by buying a stylish puffed-sleeve dress for Anne's [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) gift. Following the death of her husband, [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), Mrs. Rachel moved into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), which freed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to resign her teaching job in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and pursue her studies at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). She remained a fixture at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), helping care for the twin orphans [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, welcoming [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home during college breaks, and keeping her informed of local gossip. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepared to marry [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), Mrs. Rachel discussed the upcoming wedding with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), assisted with preparations, and wept alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as the newlyweds departed for [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). She later traveled to [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to attend [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner in their new home.

## Quotes

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I saw Mr. Harrison chasing your Jersey out of his oats today when I was coming home from Carmody. I thought he looked pretty mad. Did he make much of a rumpus?"
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "I knew there’d be trouble when Robert Bell sold his place to a New Brunswick man, that’s what. I don’t know what Avonlea is coming to, with so many strange people rushing into it. It’ll soon not be safe to go to sleep in our beds."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043)

> "And every one of them said they liked you splendid, Anne, except Anthony Pye. I must admit he didn’t. He said you ‘weren’t any good, just like all girl teachers.’ There’s the Pye leaven for you. But never mind."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026)

> "Well, I wish you would. I guess we’ll have the supper in about a fortnight’s time. Uncle Abe Andrews is prophesying rain and storms for about that time; and that’s a pretty sure sign we’ll have fine weather."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P8](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0008)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel Lynde initial meeting with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) starts off terribly when she offends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with blunt comments about her looks and red hair, provoking an angry outburst from the girl. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers a dramatic apology to Mrs. Lynde, Rachel completely forgives her and gifts her flowers, beginning their friendship. Over the years, Rachel provides advice to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) regarding Anne's behavior and comes to support her warmly.

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are longtime neighbors who frequently visit each other for tea and discuss village news and household matters. Though Rachel initially expresses strong concern and disapproval when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) decides to adopt an orphan, their close friendship remains steady, with Rachel offering practical advice on raising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and attending events together. Following a turn of events later on, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that Rachel move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can pursue college.

### [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--rachel-lynde.md)

While extracted relationships characterize Rachel Lynde and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) as enemies with strong mutual dislike, their interactions center on Rachel's active interest in his personal life and community affairs. Rachel debates his virtues with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), gossips about village matters after his cow strays onto property, and investigates the sudden arrival of his estranged wife. Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), for his part, questions her perspectives and participates in village debates where she is involved.
